description: State Road Hierarchy is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. The State-owned road network consists of approximately 3500km of road. It is a subset of the broader road network that focuses on connectivity and movement functions at State and regional levels. The State network primarily consist of roads that provide connectivity between cities, major towns, rural catchments and key port and air transport hubs. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are TRANSPORTATION-Land. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
